Pustet1862 printed135/PDF221: complete conventional same-Christ conclusion and response in full surrounding prayer, genuinely reused from this reviewer’s frozen six-case receipt.
case.verified_comparison: Target reorders Domine/quaesumus, adds qui passionem et mortem Filii tui devota mente recoluit, retains the five old petitions, and prints the full same-Christ conclusion/response. Wilson p37 has no new relative clause; p18 brackets indulgentia veniat, and p21 apparatus records omission in V and restoration from other witnesses. The apparatus is not silently promoted to uniform manuscript evidence.
case.strongest_whole_expression_contrary: The inserted relative clause adds a specific Passion/death commemoration rationale to the complete prayer and changes its liturgical application. Old petitions plus an old conclusion do not establish this revised whole as an old exact witness.
case.publication_disposition: No publication authority from this receipt. The source facts support presenting a finite whole-expression argument to Root; all prior holds remain until a fresh exact decision and subsequent authority/controller review.

case.target_unit_independently_read: CMAA PDF611 / printed530, no.2595: complete Secret through literal Per Dominum nostrum.; 200 and 400 dpi.
complete_historical_units_independently_: Acta Romana III printed551/PDF573, entire1923 Secret.

Acta Romana VI printed772/PDF790, entire1931 Secret; fascicle title PDF707 and approval printed774/PDF792.
case.verified_comparison: The1923 prayer asks acceptance of offerings and immolation of a holocaust of fidelity. Target states the offering and asks to run the commandments. Berchmans has viam mandatorum tuorum dilatato corde curramus, not per semitam; Alphonsus has monitis edocti et exemplis roborati, not the combined monitis et exemplis edocti. The1931 Secret ends Per Dominum.; target ends Per Dominum nostrum. The identity is John Berchmans, not John Leonardi.
